title: Foreigners Held Up At Kiangwan By Japanese

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

THE NORTH-CHINA SUNDAY NEWS, APRIL 17, 1932

FOREIGNERS HELD
UP AT KIANGWAN

Trouble With Japanese Over
Movie Cameras

**〔此处转录不清〕** On Friday last two
**〔此处转录不清〕** went to the Kiang-
**〔此处转录不清〕** in order to see the con-
dition of the ground for play. Both
of them were in possession of passes
(although they are not now necess-
ary) for the areas, given to them
by the Naval Landing Party. Both
of them also possessed movie
cameras and were taking "shots"
of the ruined stables, and of the
now closed Everly poultry farm
and property owned by one of them.
At least one of them was whilst the
other was interested in the Spring
flowers, peach blossoms, etc., and is
a naturalist by hobby.
They were suddenly surrounded
by a Japanese patrol who accused
them of taking pictures of fortifica-
tions belonging to their army, al-
though it is a well known fact that
the nearest fortifications are three
miles west of Kiangwanchen village.
In spite of their protests and stat-
ing that they were British subjects
they were marched to the Head-
quarters of the Japanese in Kiang-
wanchen, a distance of almost a
mile.
Here they demanded to see
an officer but all they could
get was a civilian who de-
manded that they hand over
their cameras for confiscation. This
they emphatically refused to do and
again demanded to see the officer in
charge, but all to no use. A crowd
of Japanese soldiers both on and
off duty supported by another crowd
of Kompo coolies who were enjoying
the fun gathered round, when the
Japanese capitulated by demanding
that the films be destroyed before
they could be released.
As these films cost a matter of
$25 each, the foreigners stated they
would not hand them over on con-
dition that they were given a re-
ceipt acknowledging the receipt
thereof, which they got. "Very

**〔此处转录不清〕**。上周五，两名
**〔此处转录不清〕** 前往江
**〔此处转录不清〕**，以便查看场地的
状况是否适合活动。两人
均持有该区域的通行证
（尽管目前已非必要），这些通行证
由海军陆战队签发给他们。两人
也都携带了电影摄影机，并正在拍摄
被毁的马厩，以及
现已关闭的、属于其中一人所有的
Everly 家禽养殖场及地产。
至少其中一人是出于此目的，而另一人则对
春花、桃花等感兴趣，且业余爱好
是博物学。
他们突然被一支日本巡逻队
包围，后者指控他们拍摄
属于日军的防御工事，
尽管众所周知的事实是，最近的
防御工事位于江湾镇以西三英里处。
尽管他们提出抗议并声明
自己是英国臣民，但仍被押送至
日军在江湾镇的总部，路程
近一英里。
在此，他们要求见
一名军官，但见到的
只是一名平民，该平民
要求他们交出相机
予以没收。他们坚决拒绝这样做，
并再次要求见负责军官，但
毫无结果。一群在岗和
休假的日本士兵，以及另一群
以此为乐的苦力（Kompo）聚集在
周围，此时日本人妥协，要求
在释放他们之前必须销毁胶片。
由于这些胶片每卷价值约
25美元，外国人表示，除非
给予收据以确认收到胶片，否则
不会交出，他们随后拿到了收据。“非常
